notes: These fragments receive a declared Scene, mode and actor slots, not a recreated source scheduler.
Joined cases run all three original writer fragments before executing 8003CD5C on the exact normal Sasuke spec.
Join holds teams fixed at 0 and 1 with slot 0 credited and slot 1 receiving; caps/mirrors are declared at 180.
Ranks outside the table are tested only at the write boundary, never as damage inputs.
The authored native bank choices remain explicit. The receipt does not choose live slots, manufacture a hit, or write HP.

controller_bank.extra_output: actor+0x3F3 becomes 1 only on the non-intersecting branch outside mode 2
controller_bank.inlet: assigned actor+0x3E5 bit and Mode+2 mask
controller_bank.outputs: actor+0x3E6 and +0x488 become 0 on intersection, 1 otherwise

rank.output: actor+0x43A; raw byte copied without clamping

settings.mode_1: writes bias & 31 and (31 - bias) & 31; leaves the other two bytes unchanged
settings.other_modes: no write in the tested modes 0, 3 and 255
